facts.summary: Phase 2 futility led to termination of masofaniten plus enzalutamide study and program · Phase 2 · masofaniten in mCRPC · not yet approved

evidence.summary: A futility analysis determined a low likelihood of meeting the prespecified primary endpoint of the study.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: A futility analysis determined a low likelihood of meeting the prespecified primary endpoint of the study.
evidence.safety: The combination of masofaniten plus enzalutamide was well-tolerated with no new safety signals and a safety profile similar to that seen in Phase 1 studies.
evidence.program_discontinued: Additional clinical studies with masofaniten including the combination study with abiraterone acetate and apalutamide as well as the remaining investigator sponsored trials will also be terminated
